cells.gaps: No commencement date for the 2025 Act has been found. The minister said in April 2024 that The Gambia ratified the Malabo Convention in March 2024 (GMB-014); the African Union list of 2 February 2026 records signature only (GMB-007).
cells.note: The Act is enacted but no source says it has commenced, so no law is in force and the cell stays at stage 1. Ratification alone does not raise it.
